etymology: From the pitch: the shot went in, so the posts are moved back and the point does not count.
committed_when: The evidence asked for has just been supplied.
tell: The standard changes at the moment it is satisfied, and only then.
counter: Fix the standard in writing before the evidence is gathered. If the standard moves again, the argument is over, and say so.
senses: Demanding new evidence after the original demand has been met.
It works because each new request sounds reasonable on its own. Nobody agrees to an impossible standard all at once; they agree to a series of fair-sounding ones.
example: *"Show me the emails."* The emails are produced. "Emails can be edited - show me the metadata." The metadata would not have been mentioned yesterday.

confused_with.tell: The Scotsman moves the group boundary; the goalposts move the evidentiary one.
